verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering professional legal services, not a software product with an interface that could host a built-in assistant, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. The Legaltech & ALS page describes the firm's own internal use of AI/ML tools for contract review. It does not describe a client-facing assistant that users can delegate tasks to, so the exception that would make the axis applicable is not triggered.
